title: Lineup references migrate audit-first and idempotently
decision: A dry-run audit first counts legacy `_id` references, resolvable references and empty slots without writing. The migration then renames `_id` to `playerId`, normalizes empty slots to `{ playerId: null, position }`, is idempotent, and leaves already-correct substitution `players.in/out` unchanged.
context: Production data may already have lost references, so migration decisions rest on the audit's observed data. Renaming the shared lineup schema affects team and game persistence together.
consequences: One idempotent script migrates both team and game document shapes; running it twice reports zero modifications the second time.
